summary: POD-3, podYaml's inherited-templates section, the firmware type page, espFirmware's snippet and both firmware reference files now declare yamlMergeStrategy merge() for jenkins-agent-large (JenkinsPipelineUtils 0a0d472 on phase/036-P12).
